title: [Decision] ADR-0142 D3: inject the `queue` column on every `ownership: 'user'` object (the default, so every business object today) or only where an object opts in (Salesforce "Allow queues")
body:
Ruled: 6429748166 · letter A · 2026-10-26T23:28Z

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make. Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708) after the maintainer asked, on 2026-10-26 in the director summon chat, 「帮我评估26337，是不是大部分业务对象都要加个字段？」 and 「salesforce也是这么设计的吗？」, then 「立决策卡」. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: the lane that carries PR #26337 (#25769) — the ruling changes what that PR injects, or confirms it. Dedupe: REST list of the 124 newest open + closed issues, grep `queue.*(column|inject|opt-in|allow queues|per-object)` → 0 (control `queue` → 8); #25769 and PR #26337 are the carrier, not duplicates. **New.**

## 维护者速读

ADR-0142 D3（已接受）规定：`queue` 列由 `applySystemFields` 注入到**所有** `ownership: 'user'` 的对象上，与 `owner_id` 同一批。`ownership` 省略即为 `user`（`object.zod.ts` 的枚举默认），实测本仓 `app-crm` 6 个、`app-showcase` 19 个对象文件没有一个显式声明 `ownership`，`sys_` 命名空间按既有规则跳过。所以 PR #26337 落地后，每一个业务对象都会多一列 `queue`（文本列，存队列机器名，系统列、可写、非 lookup）。这是 ServiceNow 的形状（`assignment_group` 在每张任务表上）。Salesforce 不是：它的 `OwnerId` 可以指向 User 或 Queue（多态 owner），而且**队列按对象开关**——队列只对「Allow queues」里勾选的对象（Lead、Case、Custom Object 等）可用，Account/Contact/Opportunity 不能进队列。本卡只裁一件事：列是「默认全注入」还是「对象显式打开才注入」。不裁 owner 多态（ADR Alternatives 2 已否，维护者接受合并问题 1 时已裁）。

## One-sentence problem

After PR #26337 every business object in every app gets a `queue` column whether or not that object will ever sit in a queue; the alternative is an explicit per-object switch, which is one more permanent key and one more way for a queue to silently not apply.

## Governing text

- ADR-0142 D3 (`docs/adr/0142-ownership-queue-membership-claim-and-assignment-rules.md`): *"`applySystemFields` injects `queue` … on exactly the objects it injects `owner_id` on (`ownership: 'user'`), and withholds it under the other three tiers."* An eligible object declaring its own `queue` field is refused at registration (merge question 15).
- ADR-0142 D1: *"A queue is a named, organization-scoped set of people that records of **any** `ownership: 'user'` object can sit in."* Queues are not bound to objects; assignment rules (D5) are declared per object.
- ADR-0142 Alternatives 2 (owner points at the queue, Salesforce) and 3 (queue-item join, Dataverse): both rejected; merge question 1 restates the cost and was accepted by the maintainer when the ADR merged. This card does **not** reopen placement.
- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` `ownership: z.enum(['user', 'business_unit', 'org', 'none'])` — `user` is the default; the description says `user` *"injects reassignable owner_id plus owning_business_unit_id"*.
- ADR-0117 D1: the precedent — `owning_business_unit_id` is injected by the same `ownership` axis, default tier included, with no per-object opt-in. ADR-0078 forbids an inert column; ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove applies to any new switch.

## Premises (re-check before ruling)

- P1 — no object in the two example apps declares `ownership`, so all default to `user` and would receive `queue`:
  `for d in examples/app-crm examples/app-showcase; do find $d -name '*.object.*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/dist/*' | wc -l; done` → 6, 19; `grep -rl '^\s*ownership:' --include='*.object.*' examples` → 0. `packages/platform-objects` (52 files) are `sys_` and skip injection by the existing rule.
- P2 — D3 ties `queue` to the `user` tier, not to a queue or rule declaration: `grep -n "on exactly the objects it injects" docs/adr/0142-*.md` → 1 line.
- P3 — PR #26337 (draft, +6351/−396, 183 files, "Part of #25769") implements D3 as written: read its `applySystemFields` change before ruling; if the PR already narrows injection, this card's option A is already not what is on the branch.

## Options × real cost × effort

| | What | Customer-visible consequence | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** — keep D3 as accepted: inject `queue` on every `ownership: 'user'` object | Nothing changes; PR #26337 lands as designed. | Every business object shows a system `queue` column in Studio field lists, exports and `/meta`; empty on objects nobody routes. One text column per table; no join, no extra read cost. An object that wants no queue column leaves the `user` tier (losing `owner_id` too) — the only escape, and a blunt one. | None beyond PR #26337; one sentence added to ADR-0142 Open items recording this ruling. |
| **B** — Salesforce-style per-object switch: a new object key (e.g. `queues: true`) and `queue` is injected only where it is set | ADR-0142 amendment (Tier H, maintainer approval) adding the key; `object.zod.ts` key + generated baselines + docs; `applySystemFields` condition; PR #26337 changes; the two example apps opt their routed objects in. | Objects stay lean by default; a queue, assignment rule, move or claim targeting an object that did not opt in must be **refused loudly at registration** (a rule on a non-queueable object is a registration error), otherwise the switch is a silent no-op. Authors learn one more key; AI authors will forget it. | Lane spec + objectql + sharing · 1 ADR amendment PR + 1 code PR (or one revision of #26337). No measured precedent for "new object-level boolean that gates an injected column"; the nearest is ADR-0117's tier extension, which landed as an enum value, not a switch. Estimate M. |
| **C** — inject only on objects a declared queue or assignment rule names (derived, no new author key) | ADR-0142 amendment giving `queue` an `objects:` list (D1 today binds a queue to no object); injection becomes registration-order dependent (object registered before its queue gets the column later). | Fewer columns, but whether an object has `queue` now depends on which packages are installed; moving a record into a queue whose object list does not cover it fails; a queue added in Setup at runtime cannot add a column to a live table without a schema migration. | Lane spec + objectql + sharing + metadata registry · ADR amendment + code PR; touches registration ordering, which ADR-0142 deliberately avoided. Estimate L. No precedent for install-time-derived column injection. |

## Business meaning

- A = ServiceNow: every task table has an assignment group field; routing is a property of the platform's work model, not of each table.
- B = Salesforce: "Allow queues" is a per-object setting; most objects cannot be queued, and that is a deliberate product choice an admin makes once per object.
- C = a column that appears when a package that routes the object is installed — closest to Dataverse's "enable queues for this table" but derived rather than declared.

## Four axes (business standpoint)

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：两年后平台的工作模型里，队列和责任人是同一轴上的两个落位（坐在队列里 / 由某人负责），任何有责任人的对象都应能进队列——这是 A。B 把「能否进队列」做成对象级特例，契约多一个永久键、注入规则多一条分支；C 把列的存在交给安装顺序，是最大的特例增生。参照：ServiceNow 任务表全带 `assignment_group`；Salesforce 的按对象开关是其多态 owner 时代的产物，而本仓已否定多态 owner（Alternatives 2）。
- ② 实际业务拉动：今天撞上的是 HotCRM 的 case/lead 分流（#25769 的拉动方）；没有任何客户要求「某对象不得进队列」。B/C 的拉动为零，是对列数的观感担忧。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：A 下出错只有一种形态——对象自己声明了 `queue` 字段，注册时响亮拒绝（D3 已定）。B 下 AI 写了分配规则却忘了开开关，若不加注册拒绝就是静默不生效；加了拒绝则多一条门。C 下错误形态是「换个安装顺序列就没了」，最难排查。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：A 不新增任何声明键；B 新增一个必须永久维护、文档、校验、生成基线的键（ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove 立刻适用）；C 新增 `objects:` 列表与注册序依赖。新增门禁默认否。

Prior rulings read: `queue`, `ownership`, `owner_id`, `Allow queues` → 8 hits (none on per-object opt-in); ADR-0142 D1/D3 + merge question 1 accepted; thread: #25769, PR #26337.

## Recommendation + confidence gap

**A.** ① alone picks A: the two-year platform shape is "any owned object can sit in a queue", and the maintainer already accepted D3 and merge question 1. B is not taken because its only gain is fewer empty columns, paid for with a permanent key and a new silent-failure face. C is not taken because it makes a system column's existence depend on install order.
Self-check: 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。
Gap: the seat has not measured what the empty `queue` column costs in Studio field lists and CSV exports (one extra system column alongside `owner_id`, `created_by`, `owning_business_unit_id`); if the maintainer's concern is that visible clutter rather than the schema, the remedy is a presentation rule for system columns, not an injection switch, and would be a separate card.

## After the ruling

- A: no code change. The lane carrying PR #26337 adds one line to ADR-0142 "Open items" citing this ruling (`Ruling-ref:`) and lands it inside that PR (the ADR is Tier H; the PR is already a governed draft and lands by maintainer approval). Card closes `completed` on the PR's merge.
- B: the lane opens an ADR-0142 amendment PR (Tier H) naming the key, the registration refusal for rules/queues on non-opted objects, and the example-app opt-ins; PR #26337 is revised after the amendment merges. This card stays `pm:queue` as the amendment's carrier.
- C: as B, plus a registration-ordering design in the amendment; the seat recommends against it and would ask for a second reading before any code.

**Size:** A: XS · B: M · C: L. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** A none · B/C yes (new authorable key or list on `object`).

## Related

#25769 (parent, `pm:dispatched`); PR #26337 (draft implementing ADR-0142); ADR-0142 D1/D3/D5, Alternatives 2–3, merge question 1; ADR-0117 D1 (`owning_business_unit_id` injection, same axis); ADR-0078 (no inert column); ADR-0049 (enforce-or-remove).
